# TPC-Havoc Q4_v3

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  o_orderpriority,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders AS o
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    l_orderkey
  FROM lineitem
  WHERE
    l_commitdate < l_receiptdate
) AS qualified_lineitems
  ON o.o_orderkey = qualified_lineitems.l_orderkey
WHERE
  o.o_orderdate >= CAST('1993-07-01' AS DATE)
  AND o.o_orderdate < CAST('1993-07-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '3 MONTH'
GROUP BY
  o_orderpriority
ORDER BY
  o_orderpriority
```
